pages.title: Six Rarities
pages.text: $(#777777)Common$() · white$(br)$(#20852A)Uncommon$() · green$(br)$(#C84396)Rare$() · pink$(br)$(#8952B0)Epic$() · purple$(br)$(#348DA4)Legendary$() · light blue$(br)$(#D67B23)Mythic$() · orange$(br2)Rarity is locked on the drop. Identifying reveals its equipment and rolls the supported affixes.

pages.title: Power and Price
pages.text: Tier and rarity shape the available affixes and identification cost. Better rarity also adds a stronger reveal flourish.$(br2)Native accessories keep their own mechanics. Items with fixed native powers do not receive incompatible affixes or an unsupported rarity surcharge.
